opening.argument: The video puts a purported $2,000 Domino's gift card and free-pizza benefits before viewers as an immediately actionable offer. Its title advertises “Win a $2,000 Domino's Gift Card! Only Australia,” while the description directs viewers to click a shortened link for the gift card and “Free Pizza!” Frames reinforce that instruction with “CLICK THE LINK IN DESCRIPTION,” gift-card and branded food imagery, “FREE PIZZA FOR A YEAR!,” and an “I Want In” call to action. Limited-offer messaging and repeated prompts encourage immediate engagement, yet the supplied material does not show the linked destination, any payment or data request, fulfillment, or authorization by the branded companies.
